name: Sommertest 2026
eligible_cards: every member card with at least one purchase from 6 April 2026

allocation.method: bucket 0-99 from a hash of the card number

cells.name: Kontrolle
cells.mechanics: base points only (1 point per whole franc, CHF 0.01 a point)

cells.name: Frischbonus
cells.mechanics: 5 per cent back in points on fruit, vegetables, bread and dairy bought with the card

cells.name: Dreifachpunkte
cells.mechanics: triple base points on every basket of CHF 50 or more paid with the card

cells.name: Monatsziel
cells.mechanics: a CHF 15 voucher in the week the card's spend in a calendar month reaches CHF 250

cells.name: Wochenauswahl
cells.mechanics: three app coupons a week, 20 per cent off a category chosen from the card's purchases

rewards_credited_to: the card used at the till
